title: Polarization sequences preserve monotonicity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let $is$ be any finite list of coordinates, and let $j$ be a coordinate. If $f$ is monotone in coordinate $j$, then the function obtained by successively polarizing $f$ along the list $is$ remains monotone in coordinate $j$.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
An arbitrary finite list of coordinates
The initial function is monotone in coordinate $j$
